about: R2 CAST director pass (PLAN-P §4.2; art-direction.md §1.3 A-bar R1-R8 + §7.4 grade scale: A = reads as the same finish as our pink boss at game size (3 px/pt, calibration card art/review/cast/crew.png), passes R1-R8, the 1/3 thumbnail identifies species + pose, rig/idle proofs pass, no visible penetration; B = same finish with visible modelling gaps at 2x; C = redo). Every final render below was LOOKED AT at game size, at 2x and at 1/3 (sheets in art/review/cast/). Graded by the R2 agent in a separate pass after production (no second agent was available to this lane: say so honestly); the owner's verdict overrides.

Measured on the home render (build/p/BOSSEARS/muzzle-*.json, CIELAB, fur px only): core L* 62.5 -> 58.9, C* 30.2 -> 32.9, hue 22.9 -> 16.0 deg (body 6.2: less peach / beige); fine speckle 3.18 -> 2.75 = 1.51x -> 1.34x the body's (~1.15x once scaled by its higher L*); the weight ramp rises smoothly body -> core. At 2x: a clean soft lighter pink, no frost, no stain
